settings.about_lead: Aurelle was founded with a singular conviction: fine jewelry shouldn't be reserved for velvet boxes and special occasions. We forge waterproof, tarnish-free, and hypoallergenic heirlooms designed to accompany you through every shower, swim, milestone, and quiet morning.
settings.about_story:
Every piece in the Aurelle collection begins with surgical-grade 316L stainless steel—the exact metal celebrated in luxury Swiss horology for its supreme strength and imperviousness to corrosion.

Through Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD), real 18-karat gold is vaporized and bonded at a molecular scale within high-vacuum chambers. The resulting finish is up to 10 times more resilient than traditional electroplating, allowing your jewelry to withstand ocean saltwater, chlorinated pools, daily perfumes, and sweat without ever tarnishing or fading.

In our private atelier, our master artisans finish, polish, and laser-engrave every piece individually. From meaningful coordinates and Roman numerals to loved ones' initials, we turn metal into memory.
